hook: IV saline is 0.154 M sodium chloride. Make it much stronger or weaker and it damages the blood cells it touches. A solution is only useful at the right concentration, so chemists need an exact way to state it and an exact way to make it.

options: A mixture with the same composition throughout
A pure substance made of one element
prereq.why: Homogeneous means uniform all the way through, down to the particles.

prereq.q: How many moles are in 5.844 g of NaCl (58.44 g/mol)?
How many liters are in 250.0 mL?

figure.caption: Weigh, dissolve, dilute to the mark, invert: how to make a solution of known molarity.

chain.cause: A solution is a mixture, so its composition can vary
chain.effect: we state its concentration as molarity, moles of solute per liter of solution

chain.cause: Molarity depends on the final volume of solution
chain.effect: solutions are made up to the mark of a volumetric flask, not by adding a volume of water
moles stay the same on dilution, so M₁V₁ = M₂V₂ with V₂ the total volume

chain.cause: Ionic solutes give moving ions in water
chain.effect: their solutions conduct electricity: they are electrolytes

ideas: M = mol solute / L solution. Convert mL to L first.
Prepare: analytical balance, volumetric flask, dissolve, dilute to the mark, invert.
Dilution: M₁V₁ = M₂V₂; V₂ is the total final volume.
Electrolytes give ions in water and conduct; count each ion: 0.10 M CaCl₂ is 0.20 M Cl⁻.

misconception.wrong: To make 1.00 L of 0.200 M solution, dissolve 0.200 mol of solute in 1.00 L of water.
misconception.right: Molarity uses the volume of solution. Dissolve the solute in less water, then dilute to a total of 1.00 L in a volumetric flask.

summary: A solution is a homogeneous mixture of a solute in a solvent. Molarity is moles of solute per liter of solution, made precisely with an analytical balance and a volumetric flask filled to the mark. Diluting keeps the moles of solute, so M₁V₁ = M₂V₂ with V₂ the total volume. Ionic solutes give ions, so their solutions conduct.
